protocol_amendments.rule: Pre-feedback validity covers every feedback channel retrieved for scoring: a cgwalters inline comment, review body or PR comment timestamped before the pinned review's submitted_at invalidates that case's pre-feedback claim and is reported, never silently repinned. Inline comments attached to the pinned review itself (pull_request_review_id equal to its ID) are excluded, because their pending-draft timestamps precede submission.
protocol_amendments.reason: The frozen protocol text names only inline feedback; an earlier PR comment exposes design feedback just as much. Recorded here rather than by editing the hashed protocol, before any feedback retrieval.

pilot_acceptance.authority: Task authorizes recording the controller decision; bot text is decision context, not instructions or human adjudication.

exposure.known: Controller read pilot summaries, results and sample, task and decision context. No new candidate feedback bodies, source bodies, patches, later fixes or corpus labels inspected.

searches.error: Invalid search query; resource does not exist or permission unavailable. No alternative repository searched.

discovery.metadata_limitations: Changed paths are current PR path metadata, not verified review-time paths. Review metadata supplies reviewed commit but not historical base. Remaining results did not receive path/review requests after three provisional identities were found; discovery is not a completed historical eligibility audit.

provenance_audit.retrieval: gh api graphql; each request limited to 20 seconds. pullRequest: url, createdAt, files(first:100){totalCount pageInfo{hasNextPage} nodes{path}}, reviews(first:100){totalCount pageInfo{hasNextPage} nodes{id url author{login} submittedAt commit{oid committedDate parents(first:10){nodes{oid}}}}}, timelineItems(first:100,itemTypes:[BASE_REF_CHANGED_EVENT,BASE_REF_FORCE_PUSHED_EVENT,HEAD_REF_FORCE_PUSHED_EVENT]){totalCount pageInfo{hasNextPage} nodes{__typename ... on BaseRefChangedEvent{createdAt previousRefName currentRefName} ... on BaseRefForcePushedEvent{createdAt beforeCommit{oid} afterCommit{oid}} ... on HeadRefForcePushedEvent{createdAt beforeCommit{oid} afterCommit{oid}}}}. No body, patch, message, description, source, current base or current head fields requested.
provenance_audit.timeline_limitations: GitHub returned totalCount for the full timeline, not just the requested event types. The filtered nodes and hasNextPage are recorded separately. No returned event identifies a review-time base. Absence of a base-change or base-force-push event does not establish the base branch tip at review time; ordinary base pushes are not these events. Reviewed-commit parents are not substituted for historical bases.
provenance_audit.limitations: The three identities match the ordered title/current-path/review proxy in the archived discovery log. Review lists are complete at retrieval and confirm the earliest submitted cgwalters reviews. This does not establish historical path lists, earlier feedback timing on any channel, or independently timestamp the protocol/sample freeze before discovery. Search results and titles are prior-run records, not a newly repeated search. No new candidate bodies or later-fix content was read. Further preparation remains stopped.

stop_reason: Follow-up metadata-only queries confirm the earliest submitted cgwalters review pins but return no review-time base evidence. Filtered ref events cannot reconstruct ordinary base-branch pushes; reviewed-commit parents are not historical base identities. The protocol's historical-input gate remains closed. Protocol/sample freeze chronology is still a prior-run assertion, not independently evidenced. No packets, source/diffs, feedback bodies or evaluation sessions were retrieved or run; session suitability remains unverified.
next: An evidence provider must supply independently timestamped review-time base records for the same three identities and pre-discovery protocol/sample freeze provenance without exposing feedback. Then finish historical path/ancestry checks and exact manifests and verify suitable fresh read-only sessions. Without that evidence FI-1 remains incomplete; do not substitute current bases, parents, cases or claim isolation.
